item.title: Salsa, Tequila & Taco Challenge – Tucson’s Hottest Labor Day Weekend Party
item.description: The Salsa, Tequila & Taco Challenge is back for year 13—and it’s bringing the flavor heat to Labor Day weekend! On Sunday, August 31 at the El Conquistador Tucson, over 40 chefs and mixologists will battle it out for Best Salsa, Best Tequila Cocktail, and Best Taco. You’ll eat, sip, and vote your way through a night of bold flavors, live music, lucha libre wrestling, folklorico dancers, and more. Book the Stay & Play deal for a free ticket or use code SAACA for 10% off—before this sells out!
